In order to download Astron's comprehensive User Notes,
1: Copy (Ctrl-C) the below link.
2: Select a new browser tab and paste it (Ctrl-V) to the address bar.
3\. Your browser will download the file to your downloads folder.
https://friendsofthevigilance.org.uk/Astron/AstronUserNotes.docx
We use the above indirect link method to avoid occasional browser security issues.
We suggest that you then save the file for easy future access.
You may also be interested in the writer's celestial navigation slide rule emulator programs.

|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| NOTES on using this CUSTOM STAR utility. See User Notes / Settings / "Include Custom Star" for more detail.
• Astron holds data for a single CUSTOM STAR.
• On changing this option to "YES", the CUSTOM STAR becomes visible and becomes the currently selected body. Other bodies can be selected as normal.
• On all other pages, the CUSTOM STAR name is preceeded by a "★" distinguishing mark.
• The CUSTOM STAR is shown as the last body in the body select list and elsewhere. \[Keystroke hint: Press "z" then "⯆"\]
• When option set to "YES", the CUSTOM STAR is included in all Astron utilities.
• When option set to "NO", the star is excluded and this table hidden.
• When Astron is closed, CUSTOM STAR data is remembered for next use.
• On first use, the CUSTOM STAR is set to Castor (α Geminorum).
• When entering values, RA and Dec must be in degrees and decimal degrees.
• pm RA values are in milliarcseconds of ARC, not mas of Right Ascension.
• Input data must be referenced to J2000.0 Equinox and Epoch. Astron then adjusts to the selected date and time.
• See User Notes / Settings / "Include Custom Star" for suggested link to catalogue star data. |
